author: PD4ML
description: PD4ML for PHP: HTML to PDF, PDF/A, PDF/UA, DOCX, RTF and image conversion (the PD4ML Java API through a bridge)
The Consent add-on for Contenir CMS: a cookie banner and preferences, regional modes, Global Privacy Control, Google Consent Mode v2 and script gating for every add-on's scripts.

Laminas MVC adapter for contenir/contenir-consent: consent()->head() and consent()->bodyEnd() write the cookie banner and Consent Mode, consentScript() gates a site's own embeds, consentPreferencesLink() reopens the preferences, and a route serves the banner's files.
